purpose: Teach: 野蛮/因縁/壮絶/和声/手話/威嚇/平常/直視

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療界の野蛮な慣習を医療チームで根絶します
lines.en: Ren — we're working with the medical team to eliminate brutal practices that have persisted in healthcare.
lines.style: Clear, steady opening. Measured tone without performance. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with quiet authority, but never cold.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療事故の因縁的連鎖を医療チームで分析します
lines.en: Yes — we're analyzing how these systemic problems connect, using the full medical team to understand the pattern.
lines.style: Calm, almost meditative. Slight pause before 'chain' to let the weight settle. Soft voice, but with the clarity of someone who has seen this before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 壮絶な手術の症例を、貴院、ご記録されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has documentation of those intensive surgical cases, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely curious. Slight hesitation — not uncertainty, but the careful approach of someone asking about something serious. Leans slightly forward.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、心拍の和声的リズムを医療チームで観察します
lines.en: Yes — we observe how the team's coordination creates better patient outcomes, something we track carefully.
lines.style: Steady, almost calm. Eyes steady on Ren. Not explaining, confirming. The warmth of someone acknowledging a good question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 聴覚障害者向け手話対応を、貴院、強化されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has been strengthening accessibility for deaf patients using sign language, hasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the question. Gentle respect in the voice — asking about something the questioner knows matters. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、認知症患者の威嚇行動を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes — we're researching how to respond to that behavior with compassion and understanding, not just protocol.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The word 'research' carries weight — this is about learning, not dismissing. Slightly slower pace. Eyes level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 平常時の医療体制を、貴院、整備されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital maintains those systems even in calmer times, doesn't it — that preparation stays in place?
lines.style: Curious, slightly wondering. Voice rises gently at the end. Not challenging — genuinely asking if the hospital sustains this work when there's less urgency.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の検査結果を直視する勇気を医療チームで支えます
lines.en: Yes — we support the team in finding the courage to face patient outcomes honestly, together.
lines.style: Warmest yet, but still grounded. Close to Ren — not physically but in tone. The final word 'together' carries the weight of shared responsibility. Exhales slightly after.
